confidence_flags: This is a STRUCTURAL steel roof-framing plan (member marks, sections, spacing callouts) — classified as pattern 'plan' per the project's roof_plan trap rule, not 'roof_plan'.
warnings: All roof members are hot-rolled/cold-formed STEEL (steel_section, §6a), sitting atop an RC building frame below — a hybrid structure. No rebar on this sheet.

อะเส (wall-plate/eave beam) perimeter: dashed circles sit exactly on the drawn rectangle at every grid intersection along rows B and D (columns 1,2,3,4), so the top/bottom runs are split there per §5. The LEFT (column 1, B-D) and RIGHT (column 4, B-D) runs are drawn as ONE continuous line with no visible support-circle at row C, even though a structural column (C1/C4) exists there per the footing plan — followed the as-drawn continuous line rather than assuming a mid-run split; flagged for review, confidence lowered on those two segments only.

ตะเข้สัน (hip rafters): 4 diagonal members, each running from a building corner to one of two hip-apex points. The apex points land exactly on named grid intersections C2 and C3 (confirmed by close zoom — the diagonal terminates right where the dashed grid-2/grid-3 verticals cross row C), so no dummy grid was needed. Diagonal span length is NOT computed by the model (per §4 'Span: calculated by code from the grid only') — span_length_m is left null with span_source 'unresolved' for these 4 members; the two grid-ref endpoints are sufficient for downstream length calculation.
อกไก่ (ridge beam) spans grid C2-C3 directly — a plain 2.20m grid-to-grid span, matching the printed '2.20' dimension exactly.

จันทัน (common rafters) and แปกัลวาไนซ์ (galvanized purlins) are spacing-based repeated members (like purlins in other houses) covering all 4 hip-roof planes — recorded as single summary elements with spacing_mm where printed, no individual per-rafter grid_ref, consistent with how repeated spacing members are handled elsewhere in this dataset.

แปกัลวาไนซ์ has NO size or spacing printed anywhere on this sheet (verified by close zoom of the full member legend) — only the bare label. steel_section fields are left null rather than guessed; this is a genuine gap in the source drawing, not a missed read.

จุดตั้งดั้ง (king-post strut points, 2C125x50x20x2.3mm) mark intermediate points along each hip rafter where a vertical strut drops to the framing below — these are connection/bracing points, not independently spanning members, and their exact positions along each hip diagonal were not resolved to individual grid coordinates from this sheet (recorded as one summary connection_detail element per hip rafter's presence, not 4 individually positioned entries).

จุดติดตั้งเหล็ก PLATE หนา 9มม. (9mm steel gusset plate connections) are called out with arrows pointing at the 4 building corners where hip rafter meets wall-plate — recorded as one summary connection_detail element, approximate corner positions only.
